events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened its gates in rural New York in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Flashback
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. Imagine the mud, the legends, and the sheer scale of it all. Woodstock – still the benchmark for festivals.

events.title: Anniversary Of Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away at his Graceland home in Memphis, Tennessee, in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago, the music world lost its King. Elvis Presley's impact on popular culture is immeasurable, and his voice still resonates today. A true legend gone too soon.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas in 1996, tragically passing away days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years on, the mystery surrounding Tupac Shakur's shooting in Las Vegas remains. His influence on hip-hop and music culture, however, is undeniable. Still a voice for a generation.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Guitar icon Jimi Hendrix died in London in 1970, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost a true guitar god. Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with six strings and a fuzz pedal. His sound is as vital today as it ever was.

events.title: Abbey Road Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring its iconic zebra crossing cover, in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That cover, those songs – a masterpiece that still defines an era. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the indomitable Chrissie Hynde. The voice of The Pretenders, a true rock icon, and still as cool as ever. Here's to many more!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock and roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or Liam track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that transcends generations, with a message as powerful today as it was then. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: Original iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music players, in 2001.

angles.name: Remember the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod. Suddenly, '1,000 songs in your pocket' became a reality. Remember frantically syncing your entire CD collection? Simpler times.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond, and which theme tune gets you in the mood for espionage?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music icon and founding member of The Beatles, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His legacy as a songwriter, artist, and advocate for peace continues to inspire. A true visionary.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese. From silly walks to demanding cheese, his comedic genius is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. Two discs of pure, unadulterated genius. So many classics, so many deep cuts. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Queen frontman and rock icon Freddie Mercury passed away in London in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the world lost Freddie Mercury. A voice, a stage presence, and a legend like no other. His music continues to inspire and electrify. Forever a champion.
